_comment_obfuscated: 26.x ships deobfuscated: client.jar has readable net/minecraft names and Mojang publishes no client_mappings. This is what lets Forge and Fabric mods share one name set. Set true for 1.21.x and earlier, which additionally requires the (not yet written) remap layer.

fabric._comment_intermediary: meta.fabricmc.net reports intermediary 0.0.0 for 26.2 and the launcher profile lists no intermediary library — nothing to map.

compat._comment: NeoForge 26.2.0.59 and Fabric Loader 0.19.3 depend on identical Mixin and ASM versions, so a single runtime serves both. If a future version pair diverges here, the bridge needs a shading step.

supported._comment_fabricApi: Mods depending on fabric-api will not load until the API bridge module exists. See ARCHITECTURE.md section 7.
